checks.statement: Caller supplies the independently accepted FREEZE SHA256; the runner validates its exact hash and expected schema/116 obligations before reading commands or starting the test process.

All frozen payload paths are unique, relative, normalized, non-symlink regular files with exact modes, lengths and SHA256; observed payload membership is closed around controls plus the sole new adapter.
Adapter and fixture-manifest descriptors are separately verified; all 24 bound companions and five generated inherited-inventory sources are authenticated before command selection.
Fresh per-attempt label directory uses exist_ok=False; prelaunch identity failures receive PRELAUNCH-REFUSAL.json with process_started=false.
Frozen focused/inherited argv arrays are passed directly to subprocess.Popen with cwd=repository; no shell interpretation or added product command.

Inherited command authenticates the fixed 372-ID cohort and compares actual loaded unittest IDs before execution. One non-target environment-transport Python child is declared explicitly; this is not a global process-count promise.
Ambient test-retention root keys are cleared; focused/inherited modes receive separate new output roots. The inherited command creates its own five retained roots under its nonexisting supplied root.

REQUEST records argv, cwd, current Git head, selected environment, verified freeze, runner Python executable/version, resolved command executable, and exact source hashes; production and adapter snapshots are retained.

Raw stdout/stderr files and started PID are retained; final RESULT records return code, log hashes and source-change comparison. Nonzero product test return codes are preserved, and source mutation changes success to failure.
No product imports or process execution were used to review the runner; validation is static AST plus complete source inspection.

prerequisites: Independent acceptance of the exact revised freeze, including all four candidate001 adapter findings.
Director saves the accepted frozen-control checkpoint before baseline execution or implementation edits.
Director supplies the accepted freeze hash explicitly; do not derive acceptance from the current candidate at launch time.
limitations: Static orchestration review; no claim that tests have run or passed.
The runner does not establish host admission, native target start evidence, H0/H1, full-routine acceptance, or original P28 recovery.
Existing process-start failures/interruption still require truthful attempt reconciliation by the Director; no result may be inferred merely from REQUEST or PROCESS files.
